title: JANUS Linear A SigLA word-view interface probe result

executed_contract.materialization_note: The GitHub connector exposes immutable Actions artifact metadata and digest but does not unpack the binary artifact payload. This registry node therefore records only CI-validated facts and does not invent internal DOM counts or word-view page hashes.

methodological_connections.name: ROOT_CONTENT_HASH_CAN_BE_USED_AS_A_PRE_FETCH_INTERFACE_CANARY
methodological_connections.statement: The word-view probe was allowed to execute only after each frozen document root reproduced its exact prior SHA-256, preventing silent interface drift between reconnaissance and adapter probing.

methodological_connections.name: SOURCE_ADAPTER_RECONNAISSANCE_CAN_BE_NON_SCIENTIFIC_AND_STILL_PROOF_CARRYING
methodological_connections.statement: A technical interface gate can carry immutable workflow and artifact receipts while making no transcription, lexical, decipherment or replication claim.

methodological_connections.name: BINARY_ARTIFACT_METADATA_AND_CONTENT_CLAIMS_MUST_REMAIN_SEPARATE
methodological_connections.statement: An artifact digest proves identity of the uploaded payload, but internal observations must not be reconstructed from metadata when the payload itself has not been materialized into the registry reader.

next_gate.goal: Derive and freeze a fail-closed SigLA source-adapter contract from the exact word-view snapshots and predeclared observables before any cross-source transcription comparison.
